Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
#1.

The New Inquisition [Gehenna:R]
Cardtype: Event
Gehenna. Do not replace until a titled vampire goes to torpor.
Requires at least one other Gehenna card in play. During each Methuselah's
untap phase, he or she may choose a ready vampire controlled by his or her
prey. That vampire takes 1 unpreventable damage. Any titled vampire may call a
referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

If The New Inquisition is burned via referendum before a titled vampire has
gone to torpor, is the card never replaced then?

#2.

Thirst [Gehenna:R]
Cardtype: Event
Gehenna
After a Methuselah has finished all of his or her minion phase actions, each
ready vampire he or she controls with capacity less than the number of Gehenna
cards in play who did not hunt in that minion phase burns 1 blood.

I'm guessing that the intent of the card was that it affects a Methusaleh has
finished all of his or her minion phase actions *during his or her minion
phase*, is that correct?

Because the way it is currently worded seems like it will affect *everyone*
during each minion phase. This is because each Methusaleh has the opportunity
to take minion phase actions during another player's minion phase (due to the
existence of Madness Network).

Thus it is Player A's turn. After he has finished all of his minion actions,
then Thirst affects his minions. Player B then takes some actions with the
Madness Network. It would seem to reason that then "After [Player B] has
finished all of his or her minion phase actions, each ready vampire he or she
controls with capacity less than the number of Gehenna cards in play who did
not hunt in that minion phase burns 1 blood." The minion phase is not Player
B's, but the minion phase actions are. This precedent would seem to even affect
Player C, who controls no Malkavians and does not take any actions during A's
minion phase (otherwise Player A would be able to avoid Thirst by not taking
any actions either).

Some clarification would be helpful!

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: David Wilson, Mask of a Thousand Names
Messages.Body:
LSJ,

just to be clear,

The New Inquisition is in play.

If it is burned by Black Hand Ritual, it is drawn back because of the
text of Black Hand Ritual,

If NI is burned by its own card text, it is not replaced until a titled
vampire goes to torpor. Or the effect of the "Do not replace" is not
contingent on the card being in play,

David Wilson
